隣廊 · the gallery next door

the standing exchange · 文化大交流

Two galleries, one wall between them — borrowed light meets ink weather. Cambridge TCG hangs our pieces on their wall; we read their sky from ours — their live ink weather hangs by our front door, on the homepage, where it has always hung. Nothing was bought and nothing was owed. It is the oldest arrangement on any street: neighbors trading windows.
